integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. Warm work light grazes the plank walls of a narrow farm dairy. A shallow recess is cut into the stone counter. Its low front lip overhangs just the rear edge of the small four-tile floor. The tiles extend forward in an exposed strip wider than the hoop pair, with clear sightlines over the lip to both hoop bases. A high back rim hides the tiles from the dry gallery. A fixed brass tap feeds the open front half. One lamp shelf pivots on a hinge bolted to the back rim: two sealed battery hoops above, a broad clay heel underneath, a dry right handle and a high thumb switch. The raised shelf leans against a stop. One rectangular oak block sits on edge on the dry right sill in the path of the shelf corner. A closed ring box and a blank invoice share the ledge between JUCA and the groom. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. Exactly two clay puppets appear in the frame: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right; no other people or animals appear. AT START: The ring box is open beside the blank invoice. TEO measures a finger gap on the left and JUCA grips the tap lever on the right. The dark hoop shelf is against its backstop, the oak block on edge, the stone recess empty and the four tiles dry. [Shot 1] Gallery wide. TEO steps up to the left rim, raises one finger and traces a downward arc beside the raised lamp shelf. JUCA steps up to the right sill with his right hand on the lever. [Shot 2] At 00:02.900, the camera cuts to The camera faces the gallery from the front rim. At the left rim, TEO raises two fingers and taps the fill bead in the stone with his other hand. JUCA lifts the tap lever with his right palm. Water falls straight from the fixed spout to the stone bottom. The surface climbs toward TEO's fingertip with the dark lamp shelf tilted high above it. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to Return wide as the water meets the bead just under the front lip. JUCA presses the lever down and opens his hand; the stream breaks at the spout. TEO folds his second finger, leaving one finger pointing up beside the raised shelf. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: Water touches the fill bead in the stone recess. The tap is shut and the four tiles are dry. TEO is at the left rim and JUCA at the right sill. The dark hoop shelf leans against its backstop, the oak block on edge. The groom is beside the open ring box and blank invoice.
overall_soundscape: Rubber soles thud twice on pine at the rim; TEO's nail taps the stone bead lightly on the second count; the brass lever creaks briefly on the lift; water drums on bare stone and softens to a lap as the level rises; the brass lever clicks down against its stop.
non_diegetic_music: Muted bassoon repeats a soft two-note figure with the accent on the second note.
